messages:
Ava (platform): Quick sync — product wants per-model/route SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). We need runtime + infra telemetry inputs and a low-cardinality contract. Who's available to define the schema?
Diego (eng-runtime): I can pair on this. Need to agree labels and cardinality targets first. Also we should decide whether to emit HDR histograms or raw timers.
Priya (observability): Prometheus alone won't give accurate cross-aggregation percentiles. Prefer pushing hdr/histogram buckets to our metrics pipeline (OTLP -> metrics-ingest) and compute percentiles there. Also want exemplars for trace linking.
Jamie (eng-ml): From model side we can emit request-level metadata: model_name, route, model_version, quantization, batch_size, region, deployment_tier. Big caveat: combinatorial labels = cardinality explosion.
Sonia (eng-sre): Agreed. We must cap cardinality. Suggest a two-tier approach: full-dim histograms at low-cardinality slice (model+route+env) and sampled high-cardinality telemetry for debugging (version/quant/tenant).
Mark (product): Console needs ability to show SLO line + drilldown to model version & rollout buckets (canary/stable). Also want TTFT percentile and tokens/sec trend per route.
Diego (eng-runtime): Proposal for metric names and minimal labels:
```
# histograms
inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{model,route,env,rollout_bucket}
inference_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model,route,env,rollout_bucket}
# counters
inference_requests_total{model,route,env,rollout_bucket}
tokens_emitted_total{model,route,env}
```
Keep labels to model, route, env (prod/stage), rollout_bucket (canary/stable) as optional. model_version and quantization only for sampled events / diagnostic streams.
Priya (observability): Add exemplars: attach trace_id exemplar to P99/TTFT slow buckets so Console can link to traces. Metrics pipeline must accept hdr buckets + exemplars. Also storage: raw hist for 7d, rolled aggregates for 90d.
Jamie (eng-ml): For tokens/sec, I'd rather emit tokens_emitted_total + inference_processing_time_seconds so rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]) / rate(inference_processing_time_seconds[1m]) gives tokens/sec. Simpler than a gauge.
Sonia (eng-sre): We need backpressure in runtime if unique label cardinality exceeds threshold. Diego can we sample or hash-and-drop labels at emit time?
Diego (eng-runtime): Yes — runtime will implement a cardinality guard: if unique (model,route,env,rollout_bucket) combos exceed N (configurable), switch model_version and quant labels to "_redacted" for metrics stream and emit a sampled diagnostics stream to a Traces+Logs bucket.
Ava (platform): Good. UX ask: Console rollouts page expects a rollout_bucket label. Can we standardize values: canary, stable, fallback?
Mark (product): Yes please standardize. Also add an optional numeric rollout_weight label for A/B % if available.
Priya (observability): One more: label value length should be capped (e.g., 64 chars). And model names should be normalized (no slashes).
Diego (eng-runtime): Implementation plan:
1) Draft telemetry schema PR with canonical metric names + labels (owned by Priya + Diego)
2) Runtime PR to emit metrics + exemplars + cardinality guard (Diego, 2 sprints)
3) Metrics-ingest: add hdr histogram ingest & exemplar support + retention rules (obs team, 2-3 sprints)
4) Grafana/Console dashboards + panel templates for P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec, throughput (Console: Mark + Platform)
5) Rollout UX hook: Console reads rollout_bucket label from metrics, fallback to route metadata if missing
Sonia (eng-sre): Add a monitoring alert: if unique metric series per minute grows > 2x baseline, page SRE. Also alert on missing TTFT metric for >5% of requests for a route.
deploy-bot: deploy:metrics-ingest v1.3 deployed to prod (sha: ab12f3) :white_check_mark:
Ava (platform): Action items: Priya/Diego open schema PR by EOD Thu. Diego starts runtime changes next week. Priya to update ingest docs with exemplar + hdr example. Mark will draft Console panel requirements. Sonia to write SRE alarms.
Priya (observability): I'll paste an example OTLP exporter snippet and the histogram bucket config in the PR.
Jamie (eng-ml): We'll add a lightweight client-side helper to populate labels safely and normalize names — will send a draft.
Mark (product): Timeline check — does 3 sprints sound ok to everyone for end-to-end? We need initial dashboards sooner for a couple key routes.
Diego (eng-runtime): We can get a minimal path (emit histograms & TTFT for top 5 routes) in 2 sprints. Full rollout 3 sprints.
Sonia (eng-sre): Fine. Make sure we have load testing for the metrics path so ingest doesn't become a new bottleneck.
Ava (platform): Great. Thanks all. Priya/Diego please tag this thread when PRs are opened and add the schema file under infra/telemetry. :eyes:
Mark (product): :thumbsup:
Priya (observability): Will do — starting the draft now.
